summary: HUHUTECH International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 29, 2026 press release announcing two potential Japan projects with separate existing customers, estimated at an aggregate value of approximately US$12 million, expected to advance toward contracting in Q4 2026. One covers power system engineering, the other heated piping integration, with execution anticipated from about June 2027 through end-2028 via existing Japan operations in Kumamoto and the Hiroshima Project Office. No definitive agreements or purchase orders exist; terms and timeline are non-binding estimates, so this is a routine business update, not a special situation.
